cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Let Them Think They Won
cards.instruction: Protect someone’s confidence by hiding how much you softened the challenge, changed the terms, or withheld an advantage.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You won, Mum. Put the ribbon on your cake.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You pulled yours out when the baker withdrew hers. Hers was raw; yours wasn't.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly, professional standards. There were seven other cakes for you to beat.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then share the prize money with me. I don't want a present disguised as a win.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put it toward your next entry. You don't owe me half a win just because my cake stayed in the kitchen.

reason: Remove the unsupported repeat field and answer Mum's split offer directly, preserving the concealed withdrawal and defensive confidence rather than a future performance prediction.
